An alarming report by Axios has shocked the Middle East. It raised questions about US-Saudi Arabia relations. Houthis are giving a tough time to Saudi Arabia as fighting in Yemen has intensified. As per the Axios report, Trump declined the Saudi Crown Prince’s call for US strikes on Houthis. Reportedly, MBS called the US President twice on September 10. He reportedly urged the United States to launch strikes against the Houthi rebels. As per the report, the United States was concerned about the situation in Yemen. However, it was avoiding direct military involvement against the Iran-backed Houthis.

recentItems.title: IDF's Big Lebanon Win: Troops Wipe Out Last Terror Tunnels On Al-Taher Ridge, Hezbollah Flushed Out
recentItems.description:
Israel Makes Hezbollah Cry In Pain: Last Terror Tunnels On Ali Al-Taher Ridge Demolished| Lebanon

The IDF dismantled Hezbollah’s underground infrastructure on the
Ali al-Taher Ridge.

In a statement issued afterwards, Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz said that the operation 'completed the establishment of the Security Zone in southern Lebanon.

According to the Israeli Military, their troops have successfully finished dismantling the underground routes in the Ali al-Taher Ridge region, having recently secured operational dominance over the ridge, both above and below ground.

The IDF reports that the terrorist network stretched over a distance exceeding two kilometers.

Within this infrastructure, a significant cache was discovered, including numerous Iranian-manufactured rockets, missiles, and drones. Additionally, there were machine guns, a multitude of anti-tank missiles, and hundreds of mines and explosive devices.

According to a report from the IDF released only a few days prior, the underground infrastructure housed a key facility associated with Hezbollah’s Badr Unit.

This facility featured command centers, arms storage areas, and living quarters, all of which allowed Hezbollah militants to orchestrate military operations while remaining concealed underground for prolonged durations.
